4691-5165-7666.description:
Donate control of Vilis to an opponent using Bilbo, Luckwearer // Burglar's Plot
During that player's next draw step, they draw a card.
Ob Nixilis triggers, dealing 1 damage to that opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

822-5261-7290.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-5261-7290.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-5261-7290.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Does Machines.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

728-3249-4474-5004.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-5004.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cathodion, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Cathodion from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

5170-6132-6495-6634.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

670-1619-3991-6141.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6141.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Displacer Beast.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Displacer Beast from exile to the battlefield.
When Displacer Beast enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Beast trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Displacer Beast.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

5016-6777-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5016-6777-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Unbreakable Formation.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5016-6777-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-4885.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

628-2511-7189.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

2653-2893-4500-6664.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1497-2173-5220-6794.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1170-3518-6643.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Edgar this turn if Lion's Eye Diamond is in your graveyard.
1170-3518-6643.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your hand or graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Edgar.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

277-5531-6620-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
277-5531-6620-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1479-1659-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-1659-5033.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

511-817-851-3921-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1238-2292-2351-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

132-198-549-2742.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-549-2742.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {R} or {W} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Duergar Mine-Captain's ability by paying {1}{R/W} and untapping it, giving attacking creatures +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1283-1618-3019-4067.manaNeeded: {1} if Inspiring Refrain is in your hand, or {2} available if it is in exile
1283-1618-3019-4067.notablePrerequisites: Inspiring Refrain in hand or in exile with at least one time counter on it.
1283-1618-3019-4067.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
If Inspiring Refrain is in your hand, cast it by paying {6}.
Otherwise, activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, causing you to time travel three times, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain and cast Inspiring Refrain from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.

814-3094-4659-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-3094-4659-4853.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
When the Soldier dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

1189-4831-4849.notablePrerequisites:
Hammerfist Giant does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least four greater than each opponent's life total.
1189-4831-4849.description:
Activate Hammerfist Giant by tapping it, dealing 4 damage to each creature without flying and each player.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping Hammerfist Giant.
Repeat.

1479-2232-4812.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact enchantment creature in your graveyard with a mana value of two or greater.
1479-2232-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Animate Dead trigger, returning a nonartifact enchantment creature with mana value two or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
The enchantment creature enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from the enchantment creature, returning Animate Dead from the battlefield to your hand.
Animate Dead leaves the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from the enchantment creature, putting Animate Dead from your hand onto the battlefield.
Animate Dead enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 3.

1020-2034-2906-3689.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
1020-2034-2906-3689.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying at most {2}.
Repeat.

2034-2876-3374-4085.notablePrerequisites: Elenda does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-2876-3374-4085.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Elenda persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {C}{C}.
Elenda dies, triggering its second ability and its persist ability.
Resolve Elenda's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Elenda trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to Elenda's power.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {C}{C}.
The Vampire dies, triggering Elenda's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2698-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2698-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Vogar's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1548-1744-1953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1548-1744-1953.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Port Razer.
Move to your combat phase.
Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all creature tokens you control to become a copy of the Port Razer token.
Deal combat damage with any Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1202-1737-4853-5231.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {R}.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

914-4050-5140.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4050-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {1}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Repeat.
914-4050-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1385-2012-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: Strangleroot Geist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1385-2012-4050-5189.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {1}.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist undying trigger, returning Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Strangleroot Geist, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
